title: Adafruit Motor Shield V2 (Adafruit Learning System guide PDF, last updated 2025-09-09)
supports: TB6612 1.2 A per bridge, 3 A for brief 20 ms peaks
motor supply 4.5-13.5 VDC (setup text says 5-12 VDC)
PCA9685 PWM driver over I2C, only SDA/SCL + 5V/GND used
I2C address 0x60 default, 0x60-0x7F via 5 address jumpers A0-A4, 0x70 all-call
servo headers on Arduino pins 9 and 10, powered from Arduino 5V; optional 5-6 V servo supply after cutting trace
VIN jumper vs motor power terminal
polarity protection FET on the power terminal
terminal blocks 18-26 AWG
logic 5 V or 3.3 V selectable (Logic jumper) for boards without IOREF
stepper wiring: coil 1 top two terminals, coil 2 bottom two, middle GND
stacking up to 32 shields
PCB files on GitHub

title: Adafruit product 1438 page: Adafruit Motor/Stepper/Servo Shield for Arduino v2 Kit - v2.3
supports: dimensions assembled 70 x 55 x 10 mm
I2C 7-bit addresses 0x60-0x80 selectable with jumpers
revision March 7 2024: A4/A5 disconnected, only SDA/SCL used; default logic voltage IOREF instead of 5 V
specs list (same as guide)
TB6612FNG datasheet link

title: Adafruit-Motor-Shield-V2-PCB: 'Adafruit Motor Shield v2.3.brd' (Eagle board, commit ff0173e9, 2019-06-14)
supports: board outline 68.58 x 53.34 mm
J1 M1/M2 5-pos 3.5 mm terminal: M2A M2B GND M1B M1A
J2 M3/M4 5-pos 3.5 mm terminal: M3A M3B GND M4B M4A
MPOWER 2-pos 3.5 mm terminal (+ VMOTOR via Q1 AOD417 polarity FET, - GND)
PWR jumper VIN to motor rail
SERVO1 = GND/+5V/D10, SERVO2 = GND/+5V/D9
Opt Servo 2-pos terminal on +5V
10k pull-ups R7/R8 on SDA/SCL to logic VCC
Logic jumper SJ1 5v/3v
PWMs header #0 #1 #14 #15 (PCA9685 spare channels)
A0-A4 address jumpers
A4/A5 tied to SDA/SCL on v2.3 (pre-2024)

title: Toshiba TB6612FNG datasheet (2012-11-01), linked from the Adafruit product page
supports: VM max 15 V, operating 2.5-13.5 V
IOUT 1.2 A ave per channel, 2 A 20 ms pulse duty <=20%, 3.2 A 10 ms single pulse
Topr -20 to 85 C
thermal shutdown
